browser.webglRenderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti (0x00001B82) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

meta.clock: ms = mockup virtual clock (VT.now(), = performance.now() unless paused) minus T0 set by play(0); speed 1

snd.opt: RO · Sonic Blow + katar swings + dagger hits

notes: Every helper call is recorded on entry (sync). 'via' = the helper that called it synchronously (e.g. clip via muzzle). Calls after an await inside an async helper carry no 'via'.
'.end' events (stepIn.end, backHome.end, moveActor.end, namecard.end, critCutin.end, whiteTo.end, trailMove.end) mark the promise resolving; durMs = end - start.

Random values are recorded as the actual value: sbStrike jitter (pt offset from target center, range x +-18*t.s, y -26..+18*t.s) is in clip/slashSheet anchor.offPerS; slashSheet angle noise (+-8 deg) = angNoiseDeg; miss sway distance (10..18*t.s) is in the target slide deltaPerS; forced-hit spread is in sbResults. These are marked random:true. Math.random is a seeded mulberry32 (seed per run in config).
gameNum: the number element appears showsAtDelay ms after the call (per-target 120 ms queue, DN_SLOT2); a +-13 px random x jitter on the number is not recorded.
sfx vol = call-site volume; effVolume = what the engine sets on the Audio element (vol * .75, capped 1).

clip scale is the value passed by the move; the review kit multiplies it by kitMultipliers.vfx (1 = default). scaleRelTarget = scale / Dire Orc t.s at call time; scaleRelWielder = scale / wielder a.s.
anchor.kind: exact reference point (targetCenter / targetFeet / wielderHand / wielderFeet / wielderCenter) or 'jittered:<nearest>' with the offset in px and in units of that battler's s.
addP is only recorded when called directly by a move (e.g. gb_gun tracer), not from inside sparks/twinkles/muzzle/igniteBlade/ember.
sonicblow-rolled-crit: tune result=0 (rolled dice), then strikes 2 and 5 (0-based) are forced to {hit:true, crit:true} by wrapping sbResults, to show the crit path; banner only on the first crit.
Screenshots come from separate re-runs (same config + seed); at the shot moment the virtual clock is paused (VT.pause), the shot taken, then resumed, so the ms are exact on the virtual clock.
